typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Scrub_Date as string,
		Member_Key as string,
		Job_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(isNull(Member_Key) == true(), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(IsNULLMember,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(ScrubDate = toDate(toString(Scrub_Date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE = ScrubDate,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = Member_Key,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME = Job_Name)) ~> OLEDBDestination
